quarterly_data.quarter: Eli Lilly press release: New Phase 3b data show Lilly's EBGLYSS (lebrikizumab-lbkz) (09-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: EBGLYSS (lebrikizumab-lbkz) monotherapy met its primary and secondary endpoints at Week 16 in the Phase 3b ADtouch study in adults and adolescents with moderate-to-severe hand and foot atopic dermatitis (late-breaking data at the EADV Congress): 53% versus 27% on placebo achieved clear or almost clear hands and feet (HF-IGA 0/1 with at least 2-point improvement), 57% versus 19% achieved a 4-point or greater itch improvement and 59% versus 19% a 4-point or greater pain improvement, and 77% versus 40% were satisfied or very satisfied with hand clearance; rescue medication was needed by 6% versus 18%. Adverse events leading to discontinuation were 0.9% versus 2.7%, with no new safety signals. Lilly has submitted these data to the U.S. FDA and plans to submit to select global regulators for a potential label update covering localized atopic dermatitis with moderate-to-severe hand and foot involvement.
quarterly_data.figure: ADtouch Week 16: HF-IGA 0/1 53% vs 27%; itch 57% vs 19%; pain 59% vs 19%; satisfied 77% vs 40%; submitted to the U.S. FDA for a label update
